uncertainty_assessment.inference: Prediction sensitivity to regularization and cold/nonlocal extrapolation can suggest weak identification from finite warm-temperature observations. It is not proof of irreducible finite-data uncertainty; neither estimator has been refitted or bootstrapped.
uncertainty_assessment.numerical_error: Independent dense-transfer comparisons agree to the recorded residual; observed macroscopic failures are not explained by transfer numerical error.
uncertainty_assessment.ess_limit: Importance ESS diagnoses field-tilt support at the two observed ensembles, not temperature-extrapolation support or a posterior confidence interval.
